No templates found. Maybe need to include both substrates? The search uses target molecule SMILES; we gave aryl iodide but target is product. Should use target molecule SMILES (our product) and specify broken/formed groups in forward reaction (i.e., from precursors to product). For Heck coupling, forward reaction: aryl halide + alkene -> substituted alkene (product). So functional_groups_broken: ["aryl halide"]; functional_groups_formed: maybe ["C-C double bonds"] (new double bond? but product already has double bond). Could also include "C-C single bonds". Not sure.

Let's try with functional_groups_formed ["C-C single bonds"] (valid). Search with target SMILES (product). Use product SMILES.
